notes: codex CLI routes to OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
GPT-5 and GPT-5-mini are no longer actively listed in OpenAI primary catalog as of July 2026 — superseded by GPT-5.6 family.
GPT-5.3-Codex is the dedicated code-focused model, tuned for agentic coding and long code sessions.
GPT-5.4 family (nano/mini/full) remains available and is the cost-efficient mid tier.
GPT-5.6 family (Luna/Terra/Sol) is the current flagship, released July 2026.
Batch API offers ~50% discount on standard rates — not reflected here (standard rates only).
Model IDs match the --model flag passed to the codex CLI binary.

models.notes: Cheapest OpenAI model available. Use for heartbeats, health checks, high-frequency bounded tasks.

Dedicated code model. Tuned for agentic coding and long code sessions. Best OpenAI option for complex code transformation.
